issues.symptom: Lifecycle updater accepted a summary with infrastructure failures and still wrote pilot empirical status.

root_cause.cause: validate_summary filtered to graded runs but did not reject summary-level or run-level infrastructure failures before metrics were computed.

hypotheses.evidence: A RED fixture with infra_failures=1 was accepted before the fix.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The updater only fails when no graded runs exist.
hypotheses.evidence: validate_summary raised only when the filtered graded run list was empty.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Review writing itself caused the false status.
hypotheses.evidence: The false status was already present in the object returned by update_review.

issues.fix: validate_summary now rejects summary blocks with infra_failures > 0 and any run carrying infra_failure.

red_green.red_result: [FAIL] updater accepted a summary with infrastructure failures

issues.symptom: without_skill baseline could receive the target SKILL.md through eval case files.

root_cause.cause: copy_case_files had no run_mode context and allowed target skill-root files to be copied into the temporary workspace.

hypotheses.hypothesis: prepare_workspace copied the skill in without_skill mode.
hypotheses.evidence: prepare_workspace only copies the skill when run_mode == with_skill.

hypotheses.hypothesis: case file copying can reintroduce the target skill.
hypotheses.evidence: A RED test called copy_case_files with files: ["SKILL.md"] in without_skill mode.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Only absolute paths can leak the target skill.
hypotheses.evidence: The leak used a relative eval file path resolved against the skill root.

issues.fix: copy_case_files now accepts run_mode and rejects target skill-root files during without_skill runs; runner passes args.run_mode.
